name: – After § 25 – Am 2/2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text: 25a. Calls for strict oversight of EU-funded humanitarian assistance to Yemen, independent verification of implementing partners, and effective safeguards against direct or indirect diversion to armed groups and affiliated entities or individuals; calls for the suspension of affected funding where diversion is substantiated and safeguards cannot be restored;
